body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: **F5. Corvint duplicates the corvint-tasks wire vocabulary with no compile-time link.** - **Severity:** low. - **Core:** no. - **Location:** `src/internal/taskman/decode.go`, against `tasks-src/internal/wire/codes.go`. - **Failure:** a new code or key in corvint-tasks makes Corvint's decoder reject valid output or accept a changed shape, and no test fails in either repository. - **Fix:** import the wire package once the source is in-tree (3). Otherwise add a digest-checked manifest. - **Votes:** 1/0/1. - **Known ticket:** none.
